services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Since opening in fall of 2025, the Gibson has established itself as a distinctive and elegant venue for private events. The museum is ideally suited for standing cocktail receptions of up to 125 guests and intimate seated gatherings of up to 30 guests. Different exhibition layouts may affect event configurations and create certain setup limitations. Musical entertainment is welcome; however, all audiovisual requirements are the responsibility of the renter. We are unable to accommodate art exhibitions as part of event rentals. Please note that rentals are not available during regular museum operating hours. Kindly inquire regarding availability and to discuss all details of your event
